gaps: bid on an Upcoming stage (requires an upcoming/draft RFQ setup with a future start time, which is not available in the single-recipe setup vocabulary)

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Order not active”, and never with a server error.
